items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I admire George Shearing very much, and I like him personally.

ctx.x: sing. Hear how she sings. Then you try to play to make her happy. You don't play too much, you don't play enough, this, that, you know... And of course, all singers are crazy. Like George Shearing says, what's that famous thing he said...? "There are four sexes, male, female, homosexual and girl singers." And I think he said it right.
Incidentally, speaking of George Shearing, I think he is probably one of the finest solo pianists I have ever heard in my life. I admire George Shearing very much, and I like him personally.

But to get back to the singers... I played for so many singers, I can't even tell you... One of the finest, one of the best singers I ever played for wasn't a Jazz singer. That's the funny part of it. Evelyn Knight. She was a socialite type. She worked at the Palmer House, and this and that, you know... Boy, what a woman! She was something else. I loved that girl! And she sang songs like "Grandfather's Clock" and "A Little Bird Told Me That You..." -- and she didn't want me to do nothin' but just OMM-CHI,…
